policy: Reviewed display associations only. Preserve both original datasets, geometry, IDs, licenses and ranking values. Prefer the original OpenSkiData outline; use these Tirol planning polygons only for the four point-only ranking records. Do not publish dissolved, buffered or invented boundaries; temporary unions are used only for auditing.
attribution: OpenSkiData/OpenSkiMap, OpenStreetMap contributors, Skimap.org, Who’s On First, Mapterhorn; Land Tirol – tiris. Polygon geometry is delivered separately under CC BY 4.0.

matches.label: SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental
matches.reason: Direct named SkiWelt planning polygon plus the separately recorded Choralm/Westendorf–Kandleralm/Brixen component. Westendorf belongs to SkiWelt; omitting the southern polygon would miss this component.
matches.qualification: Historical planning envelopes, not a verified current operational boundary.

matches.label: Serfaus–Fiss–Ladis
matches.reason: The Komperdell planning envelope contains the source resort point and spans the Serfaus/Fiss/Ladis mountain area. The association is checked against the resort's source run records rather than the historical name alone.
matches.qualification: Historical Komperdell planning envelope; not an assertion of complete current coverage.

matches.label: Ischgl–Samnaun
matches.reason: Silvretta Schiarena is the matching Ischgl planning envelope, not neighboring Galtür, Kappl or See. The source point lies within it. The resort is cross-border, whereas this Tirol dataset does not supply a Swiss Samnaun boundary.
matches.qualification: Partial coverage: Tirol's 2011 planning envelope only; Samnaun/Swiss extent is not supplied. Chart length still includes the full cross-border resort.

matches.label: Sölden
matches.reason: Previously reviewed Ötztaler Gletscher association: source point containment and source piste intersections establish the match. Do not add nearby Obergurgl, Hochgurgl or Vent merely because they share the valley.
matches.qualification: Historical Ötztaler Gletscher planning envelope, not an equivalent current Sölden resort boundary.
